332d4e6c-c83f-4189-9480-2dbdc71f4074.content: Use this record when recommending coffee or a cafe to the user, including for studying, chatting, or visiting cafes while traveling.

81b3e686-b27e-4675-a833-9426f95fd646.content: The user dislikes flavored coffee, meaning coffee made from beans with added flavoring. It is fine for a cafe to offer it, but the user does not want to drink it, even for free. Clearly labeling it is fine; the user gets upset when served flavored coffee without being told.

e4f03c05-25b9-4831-8c43-be2e7e298fbd.content: The user likes iced Americanos and drip coffee.

3e5f7379-7a9e-4bdc-9452-2af023d69d4a.content: The user dislikes sugar in iced Americanos and wants only coffee, water, and ice.

bb54dc51-f00d-4ab5-9a1b-9579f4cb2694.content: Lattes are also acceptable, but the user generally prefers iced Americanos.

50249cbf-6daa-4446-b9fc-9499fd70bc18.content: For iced Americanos, the user prefers coffee described as "medium to light" and dislikes bitterness.

ae66b5bf-e85a-4c8c-9e22-cbcec4b8c924.content: For lattes, the user likes slightly bitter coffee beans.

e07cc84f-c2f4-476e-b014-dd7997f961eb.content: The user wants plenty of ice in an iced Americano. At least half the cup should still be filled with ice when the drink is served.

b75a09e8-fc7a-407f-abb1-f22703cba752.content: Some cafes, especially those accustomed to making hot coffee, underestimate how quickly hot espresso melts ice and serve a watery drink. The user dislikes this and wants ice to remain in the drink.

88ce32e2-10ba-4ae2-a092-1dcc7e5f3f81.content: For lattes and similar drinks, the user likes plenty of sugar: about two to three sugar cubes for a drink with a double shot of espresso.
